text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Osaka Hai. In the land of 
Dubai—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye crosses the finish line! 
Back-to-back victories following the Japan 
Cup!! A magnificent triumph in her 
international debut!!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your victory! First, 
could you give us a comment on how you're 
feeling right now?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was my first overseas expedition, but I 
was able to seize victory, so I am very 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
However, there are still so many Umamusume 
I want to defeat!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll take on new challenges from here and 
win even more! So please keep cheering me 
on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
――Almond Eye won that Dubai International 
GⅠ in spectacular fashion, too!! She's on 
such a roll, seriously no one can stop 
her!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"This Osaka Hai will probably decide who 
her domestic rivals are going to be. I 
guess Kiseki's the most likely contender, 
huh~?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...It was truly incredible. Ai-san's run 
in Dubai, I mean."
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was truly impressive content.
Yeah, that was truly impressive content.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's her first time racing 
overseas, she carries herself with even 
more regal presence than she did at the 
Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't even beat the Umamusume Ai-san 
has already defeated, then—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Returning as the "Queen" is nothing more 
than a pipe dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Lucky Lilac today, a razor-sharp 
determination oozes forth—she is ready to 
reign as "Queen" once again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, it will be a tough race. 
But the way she is now, she can definitely 
overcome it...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I'll show them. Right here in 
Osaka, our comeback drama...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
This atmosphere— It truly feels like a 
Senior-class GⅠ.
Lalaaaaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to today—!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Waf...!? B-Blast-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, pouncing on me out of nowhere 
like that... You're as passionate as ever, 
aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I rarely get to run with you, Lala, so 
being together in a GⅠ like this makes me 
sooooooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hit Lala with all the bonds from 
everyone who supports me! Boo is 
definitely not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Just as I'd expect, Blast-san. You're in 
top form today too; I can really feel your 
sheer capability.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Among our generation running the Classic 
Triple Crown, she's definitely a cut above 
the rest. ...Which is exactly why—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be giving it my all in our match, 
too. Make sure you enjoy it."

Nice~! Now this is a classic hot-blooded 
sports anime development!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Classmates who walked different paths 
reunite on the grand stage of battle! 
Pitting their growth against one another!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It has such a universal emotional vibe, 
doesn't it~...! Mmm, it's so passionate!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki-san. ...I am glad to see you in 
such fine form.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Lala-chan too! I can tell. She might be 
quiet... but she's burning with passion 
inside!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We are comrades who both carry the 
foreshadowing of a thrilling drama. Let's 
make today's race an absolute masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Is it foreshadowing for a drama?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The story so far! Defeated by Ai-chan at 
the Japan Cup, Kiseki aims to become the 
strongest in medium distance to get her 
revenge!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Ah, I see how it is. In that 
case, I'llâ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Watching the Japan Cup made me realize 
the sheer difference in caliber between me 
and Ai-san. Even so, my spirit isn't 
broken."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"To stand as 'Queen' once again in my own 
way, I'm definitely gonna win today's 
Osaka Hai...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...This is my script. It's my story, and 
I won't let anyone overwrite it."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Nice, so thrilling...! This'll make 
the ultimate hook for the readers...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fair and square, let's see whose story 
burns hotter! Lala-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Their rivalry, their feelings! Clashing 
today here at Hanshin!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My running is a diverse crystallization— 
its brilliance is infinite! Can you read 
it to the end!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(She's got plenty of spirit. And that 
terrifying unpredictable edge of hers is 
still very much alive, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Bring it on. No matter what tricks you 
try, I'll crush you head-on...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we begin? Our Osaka 
Hai...!
